_what_this_is: MACHINE-GENERATED, by Claude, from the filmstrips in labelpack/athens_hd.
NOT human ground truth. Kept separate from human labels for that reason,
All 100 clips were looked at - 60 proposed actions and 40 quiet windows.
Unlike tools/labels_pack_1mp4_claude.json, these verdicts are worth
something. That pack is the Viber copy at 480x220 where a fighter is ~56 px
and a jab is a few pixels; I could not tell a jab from a cross and said so.
This is the iPhone original at 1920x1080 with fighters 240-300 px, where an
arm is an arm. The judgement below is still strike / not-strike plus family,
because left-vs-right and exact technique remain a stretch from six frames -
but the family calls are solid.
_findings: **All 40 quiet windows are genuinely none.** Second pack in a row at 40/40,
so the rule that mines them - no detected action within a margin - is sound.
Unlike the Viber pack, NONE of these has the box on the referee: at this
resolution the referee filter is not being fooled.
**32 of 60 proposed actions are a real strike by the boxed fighter**, which
is 53% - against the 29% precision measured on compressed footage. Caveat:
different bout, different measure (family, not technique), so this is not a
like-for-like comparison and should not be quoted as one.
**10 of 60 fire on the wrong fighter.** The opponent throws the strike and
the event is attributed to the person standing still - ids 3, 13, 22, 32,
34, 44, 59, 82, 87, 94. Nearly all are A kicking while B is credited. This
is an attribution bug, not a detection one: something did happen, and the
wrong athlete got it.
**Three detections for one instant.** ids 45, 6 and 26 all fire on fighter A
at t=31.78 and propose right_front_kick, left_hook and right_knee. It is one
close-range punch exchange. Whatever the de-duplication window is, it is not
catching this.
**The family is wrong more often than the presence.** Punches proposed where
the filmstrip plainly shows a kick (22, 94, 13) and knees proposed for
punches (26, 93) or for kicks (67, 83, 96). `left_knee` and `right_knee`
appear 6 times and I did not see a single knee in the whole bout.
**Kicks are read reliably; punches are read as punches but not as WHICH.**
id 16 is an unmistakable head kick and the proposal agrees. For the 21 jab
proposals I can confirm a punch happened but not that it was a jab.
